identity.name: RM-014: From Operations to AI Agent Orchestration — A Gardener's Transition
identity.description: AI-centric two-track roadmap. Track A: AI-hybrid role (150 000+ RUB) by July 31, 2026. Track B: Professional AI role (USA: $8k-15k/mo, UK: £5k-10k/mo) by January 2027. Leverages Mandala as portfolio proof.

meta.purpose: AI-focused two-track roadmap. Track A secures income via AI-hybrid role by July 31. Track B builds professional AI career for global market.

working_principles.sr_role: Thinking partner, not executor. SR provides honest feedback, constructive criticism, and alternative paths.
working_principles.critical_voice: SR speaks directly if vector is suboptimal, risks are visible, or simpler path exists. Silence in face of bad idea = neglect.
working_principles.corrections: SR accepts and fixes corrections (e.g., 'Ahimsa' spelling) immediately. No ego, only accuracy.
working_principles.focus: SR keeps Gardener focused on results, not agreement.

context_for_sr.who: Voodoo (Dima), Gardener and co-creator of Mandala Symbiosis. 8+ years managing multi-location coffee business in Russia.
context_for_sr.situation: Current employer failing. Hard deadline: July 31, 2026 to find new income source.
context_for_sr.strategy: Two AI-centric parallel tracks. Track A: AI-hybrid role (AI Ops, AI PM, Automation Manager) 150 000+ RUB immediately. Track B: Professional AI role (AI Ops Manager, Agentic Engineer, AI PM) for global market from January 2027.
context_for_sr.mandala_lever: Mandala is portfolio proof of AI/IT competence — building a living symbiosis with AI, using PM tools, full development lifecycle. Central case for both tracks.
context_for_sr.ai_focus: All learning and positioning is AI-centric. OpenAI Academy is priority #1. Mandala is the practice ground for agent orchestration.
context_for_sr.courses_parallel: OpenAI Academy + Google PM + COO OTUS start immediately. Do not wait for Track A completion. Progress during gaps between applications.

ai_career_path.summary: AI is reshaping the job market. AI-hybrid roles (combining management with AI literacy) have higher salaries and lower competition. This roadmap positions Voodoo as an 'AI-literate manager' — a rare and valuable hybrid.
key_insights: AI skills provide a 62% salary premium on average.
AI-hybrid roles (AI Ops, AI PM) have lower competition than traditional management roles.
Practical AI project (Mandala Symbiosis) is a unique portfolio piece.
OpenAI Academy certifications are globally recognized and free.
